releaseBoundary.note: Archive a deliberate public corpus release; evaluation or operational files should be included only when they are part of the documented dataset contract.

steps: Freeze the 1.0.0 public corpus release and compute SHA-256 checksums.
Publish the frozen release through Zenodo or another appropriate persistent archive.
Verify the archive record and issued DOI.
Update this file, data/dataset.jsonld and CITATION.cff with the issued DOI.
Use a new versioned archive release when cited corpus bytes materially change.

guardrails: No DOI is claimed before an external archive issues one.
A DOI is a persistent citation/version identity signal, not a Search ranking guarantee.
Live mutable data and archived release identity must not be silently conflated.
